implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Defines the POST /tasks endpoint, receives a TaskCreate object, and delegates creation to the database logic. Entry point for task creation requests.
implementation.name: create_task
implementation.pseudo_code:
ON POST /tasks WITH payload TaskCreate:
    CALL add_task(task) in database
    RETURN created Task
